capabilityRoute.reason: The adapter and browser demo can be built and exercised here, but the user's actual Xbox-style controller is not exposed to the test browser.

implementation: Standard Xbox-style aliases and legacy numeric binding compatibility
Analog trigger coercion and D-pad axis composition
Explicit connected, disconnected, unsupported, error, and stopped status
Phone-optional host demo with a visible controller map
Sticky fully-visible game canvas at a 1280x720 browser viewport

claims.passCondition: A declared Xbox layout produces normalized MOVE, AIM, PRIMARY_ACTION, DODGE, and NAVIGATE values without game code reading raw buttons.
Crossing the aim threshold and returning below the release threshold produces exactly one PRIMARY_ACTION pulse followed by neutral state.
At 1280x720 the full game canvas, control legend, connection state, controller state, and gameplay context are visible without horizontal overflow.
claims.counterevidenceAndResolution: proof/XBOX_BRAWL_HOST_BEFORE_LAYOUT_FIX.png showed the canvas vertically centered against the tall sidebar; demo/host.html was corrected and re-observed.

claims.passCondition: Escape/Menu changes Gameplay to Menu controls with a visible overlay, and the second press restores Gameplay.
The user's controller reports the standard browser mapping and passes movement, aim, fire, menu, disconnect, and latency checks on the real game-test machine.
claims.evidence: No physical gamepad was exposed to the in-app browser.
claims.nextCheapestTest: Run docs/18_XBOX_BRAWL_CONTROLLER_TRIAL.md with the user's controller.
